status: designed 2026-10-08; NOT_EXECUTED. STAGING ONLY: the pack is installed by hand into the staging world's datapacks/ and never into the players' pack or tools/reapply.py's install lists (tests/test_dungeon_probes.py holds both)
why: docs/mechanics/DUNGEONS.md section 14: small proofs that can kill a mechanism before the Night Shift engine is built. One self-contained probe per row of the table except DX1, which waits for the run tag (E1).
rung: datapack plus functions/commands (CLAUDE.md principle 6): every probe uses vanilla commands and Cobblemon 1.8.0's own commands (spawnnpcat, spawnpokemonat, runmolang) and callbacks. Nothing here proposes a mod or a script layer.
dimension_from: data/portals.json pocket.dimension; tools/dungeon_probes.py fails closed if the two disagree

row.why: one 256 x 128 area per probe along z -704..-577. z < -512 is outside the portals' rescue box on every x (data/portals.json pocket.bands 0 and 256, rescue_margin 512: z from -512 up); x >= 1024 is outside Entei's band box (data/entei_boss.json: slots x -768..-384 at z -768, plus the keeper's 64-block sweep margin: x -840..-312), whose sweep would eject anyone standing in it; and z < 0 is outside the dungeon slots' rows (DUNGEONS.md section 1: from z 1,024). The generator recomputes all three boxes from their own data files and refuses an overlap.

floor_y_why: feet level, as data/portals.json pocket.floor_y and data/entei_boss.json pocket.floor_y: the generated bedrock plane is at y0, so every probe stands on its own platform with walls
ready_wait_ticks_from: tools/chunk_look.py BLIND_TICKS (300): setup force-loads the probe's chunks and holds them until cleanup; nothing is summoned until `ready` has run 300 ticks later and killed whatever of an earlier run's tagged entities arrived (review N155). A probe's first run has nothing saved to look for, so the blind wait is the whole look.

Does minecraft.mined count in adventure mode with the rift pick under can_break?
Does minecraft:can_break on a pick in adventure mode break the seam ores and nothing else?
Does a teleport mid-fall keep the fall distance, with and without resistance 5?
Are a glowing sleeper, lanterns, a bubble column and a beacon readable from a gantry 40 above the bed?
Does a wild battle start and finish underwater, with and without Dive?
Does a macro spawnnpcat work after a plain restart, and does a victory's follow-up start the next fight 60 ticks later, three times in a row?
probes.stages_why: four stages, so a victory's follow-up starts the next fight three times in a row (the table's 'three times'); the boss has three stages and so two follow-ups. Weak singles, so the chain is quick to win

probes.title: How many ticks does an NPC fight take at 2, 4 and 6 opposing members at caps 20, 45 and 100, and a 3-stage chain?
probes.skill_why: the NPC class's skill, inside the range Heaven's Arena gives its ranks (tools/arena_runtime.py SKILL, 3 to 5); a timing reading is only comparable at the skill it was taken with
probes.teams_why: timing fixtures, not balance: species, items and moves read from Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar (species/*.json and models/item/*.json, 2026-10-08). Absent moves are left to Cobblemon's level-up set. The real teams are trainer-balance-designer's; a fight's length depends on the owner's party, which the owner records beside each reading. The chain is DUNGEONS.md 3.2's stage rule at cap 45 (cap-2, cap-1, cap; a different moveset and held item each)

probes.title: Are a rip's particles and displays seen from 32, 64 and 128 blocks; force mode; a plume?

probes.strip_why: one slot's strip (DUNGEONS.md section 1: 2,048 long, at most 64 wide) on its own row at z -960..-897, inside the border margin (z >= -992) and disjoint from the probe row and every box above. The shell here is a bedrock hull with its interior cleared: the real shell's dressing is the builder's to report (11.3), so this measures the hull, the 512 chunks it force-loads in two adds, and the clear of a dressed interior (dirty_blocks)
